body:
Authorized installation repair under Myk's explicit instruction to resolve the ADLC revision mismatch and continue autonomously. Work in repair/adlc-phase-revisions, isolated from the receiving proof. Installed/latest @adlc/cli, runner and prosecute are1.11.0. Prosecute records git-change identities; runner assertPhase and recordAcceptancePacket compute git-worktree identities and reject unchanged reviewed code. Preserve the failed original reproduction in /tmp/loam-receiving-p5/adlc-revision-defect.json.

Add an idempotent deterministic local installation patch using Loam's scripts/patch-adlc-*.mjs pattern, with a test-only explicit runner-root option. Prevalidate all target source/version shapes before writes, refuse unexpected/drifted states, verify writes and complete idempotence. Add --base to runner CLI and both library entrypoints. A shared helper computes git-change via the existing core resolveChangeSetRevision only when selected recorded P5 identity is git-change; caller must supply a nonblank current base, never derive trusted base from the recorded hash or pass an explicit revision to the resolver. Preserve existing git-worktree evidence behavior. Because change-set identities omit untracked paths, reject untrackedNonIgnoredPaths with the exact same evidence exclusions; errors fail closed. Update assertPhase P5/P6 and acceptance recording consistently. Preserve all transcript/prompt/input/ticket/completion checks and explicit-revision compatibility; do not use explicit revision to demonstrate the repaired live gate. Existing supported evidence paths only; no broad new exclusions. Add patch to npm adlc:patch.

Independent P1 design review confirmed this shape and required untracked refusal, caller-base selection, merge-base-sensitive tests, and both P6 consumers. No user policy decision needed: this repairs existing freshness enforcement, not a waiver.

RAILS FIRST: New test file drives real installed ADLC copies and real temporary Git repositories. Measure unchanged-runner positive failures before applying patch (not module absence); record accepted negative controls. Tests must fail loudly in CI if ADLC is absent, with explicit local skip matching existing tool tests. Verify actual runProsecution produces legitimate fixture P5 evidence, then repaired assertPhase p5, recordAcceptancePacket, and assertPhase p6 succeed unchanged. Test tracked unstaged/staged/committed edits, edit-after-stage, executable-mode changes; untracked source refusal and ignored/evidence-only tolerance; missing/blank/missing-ref and genuinely different-merge-base rejection; equivalent base aliases allowed; transcript/prompt/input modification and selected ticket changes/deletion refuse; old git-worktree evidence retains unchanged success and dirty refusal. Exercise CLI --base run and accept, idempotence, drift refusal before partial writes. Freeze after measured red, then implement. Only fixture data may be created/deleted. Run focused tests, meaningful semantic mutation denial controls and independent review, full isolated npm run check, frozen-rail CI guard, Gemini3.8Flash as authorized. Apply globally only after concrete validated patch and review; no bypass of staleness guards. No Loam runtime or receiving rail changes. Do not claim overall T281/T282/T283 acceptance from this patch alone.

INITIAL RED:17cases,16failed/1legacycontrolpassed against actual installed runner using LOAM_ADLC_UNPATCHED=1. Failures include live algorithm mismatch, unsupported CLI base, and absent patch file (the latter is not behavior-red). Log /tmp/loam-adlc-phase-evidence/red.log. Before freeze corrected fixture acceptance path to an external owned temp directory so later P5 mutation checks cannot be masked by its untracked acceptance packet; added unchanged P5/P6 controls after acceptance. Freeze SHA256 da21d29ff19b91f392cff833e50b8283a2efeb36ed05f07dbcced3e842560c0a.

Validation correction after initial rail freeze: added TypeScript-only interfaces for dynamically imported installed JavaScript modules to satisfy strict lint. Assertions and runtime test behavior unchanged. New test SHA256 693aba1e325496b4b4c0e364fb8e290352024ec9cc62144b012e9b3ed6960dd2. Independent implementation reviewer found no blocking defect; suggested expanded base and legacy untracked controls. All17behavioraltests passed before type correction; typecheck and strict lint pass after it. Installed package remains unchanged pending external review. Exact source pins intentionally refuse future toolkit drift; do not relax them automatically.
title: Align ADLC live phase checks with recorded change identities
